Interface PlayerControls

All Known Implementing Classes:
PlayerFeedback, VisualizationController
public interface PlayerControls
Defines control actions for a visualization or playback system.

Implementations translate these high-level control signals into concrete behavior (e.g., updating state, triggering animations, or providing user feedback).
